QuestInfo.name: Wing Master
QuestInfo.0: As you enter the Power Plant, you hear a familiar voice... It can't be!
QuestInfo.1: #r#p1033230##k, one of the Black Mage's commanders, appears! How can she still be alive? There's no time for chit-chat! Defeat #p1033230#! #o9300435##r #a240911##k
QuestInfo.2: #p1033230# was much weaker than you remember, but you still barely managed to defeat her. However, this was all the proof you needed that the Black Mage was coming back. Would you be able to beat him a second time?

1.0: Huff... Huff... I won. #p1033230# isn't as strong as she used to be... I'm just lucky her twin wasn't here, too. That was too close...

yes.0: What of the child? Is he okay?
